long: Md Tauhidul Islam is a philosophy graduate from Dhaka, Bangladesh, who studied at Jahangirnagar University. His studies covered logic, ethics, and the philosophy of mind and language, including the ethics of technology. He is interested in what new tools, artificial intelligence included, change about how people think and live, and he likes to explain hard ideas in plain words. Alongside his studies he has taken part in student events, helpdesks and community work.
